info.title: DDADAN Coupon API
info.description: 상점별 쿠폰·도장 발급 시스템 API. 모든 경로는 `/api/coupon/v1` 아래에 있으며, JSON 필드는 snake_case, 식별자는 UUID 문자열, 시각은 RFC 3339 UTC, 금액은 원 단위 정수입니다.

post.summary: Approve a previewed correction and queue it (§11.5, ADMIN-003).
post.description:
Re-authentication is required: ADMIN-001 groups 원장 보정 with the actions that demand
it, and §3.3 additionally requires the approver to be somebody other than the person
who asked — which is why this endpoint exists at all rather than the preview simply
executing itself.

post.summary: Queue an erasure (ADMIN-006 삭제).
post.description:
The request does not erase anything: it registers the obligation, records the case that
authorises it, and queues a job that runs after the grace period. §17.3's hold check
happens both here and in the job, because a dispute can open in between.

post.description:
The runbook step after a restore. Safe to run at any time — the erasure is idempotent —
and `reapplied > 0` outside a restore means something wrote an erased subject back,
which is worth an alert rather than a shrug.

patch.description:
§17.3 makes these configuration rather than constants precisely so they can change

post.description:
Re-authentication is required, and a permanent sanction additionally names a second
administrator: §3.3's 이중 확인. The database refuses an approver who is the requester,

post.description:
The rate limit runs *before* the transaction, not after: SEC-003 wants a bot slowed
down before it can take stock, and is explicit that a legitimate customer must never
have a coupon revoked after the fact.

post.summary: Accept a delivery callback.
post.description:
Three checks, in this order, because each one narrows what the next may trust:

1. the timestamp is inside the skew window — an old signed body cannot be replayed;
2. the HMAC over `timestamp.body` verifies in constant time;
3. the `provider_reference` names a delivery of ours on this channel.

Failing 1 or 2 answers 401 without saying which: distinguishing "your signature is
wrong" from "your timestamp is stale" tells an attacker which half to work on. Failing 3
is a 200 with `IGNORED` — the provider did nothing wrong, and retrying will not help it.

parameters.description: Provider slug, e.g. fcm or alimtalk

AdjustmentPreview.description: What running the correction would do — and what must not have changed by then.

affected_coupon_ids.description: Rewards the correction would have to take back.

blockers.description: Reasons the correction cannot be run as described.

ledger_entries_to_append.description: The ledger rows the correction would append. Nothing is ever rewritten.

observed_versions.description:
The `version` of every mutable row this correction depends on. If any of them has
moved when execution is attempted, the preview is stale and must be retaken.

preview_expires_at.description: After this, the preview must be taken again (§13.4).

snapshot_taken_at.description:
Taken inside a `REPEATABLE READ` transaction, so every number below is one
consistent picture rather than a series of separate reads (§13.4).

case_id.description:
The case this correction belongs to. §11.5 requires an adjustment to hang off a
case, not to appear from nowhere.

internal_resolution.description: Only returned to the roles §3.3 lets act; `SUPPORT` sees `null`.

AdminLedgerEntry.description: One entry of the append-only stamp ledger, as an investigator reads it.

AdminRewardSummary.description: A reward this transaction created, and where it ended up.

AdminTransactionDetail.description: `GET /admin/transactions/:id` — one id, the whole story (§2.1 목표 5).

customer_key.description: The customer's pseudonymous key. Never their email, phone or name (§11.5 마스킹).

timeline.description: Everything above, merged in time order.

AggregationState.description: Whether a day's numbers are settled (§19: 실시간 수치와 확정 배치 수치를 구분한다).

pending_days.description:
Days the batch has not reached. Non-zero means the totals below are incomplete, and
the client is expected to say so rather than present them as the period's result.

ApproveAdjustmentRequest.description: `POST /admin/adjustments` — approve a previewed correction and queue it (§11.5).

adjustment_id.description:
The preview to execute. §13.4 requires the execution to be of a specific snapshot,
not of a freshly recomputed plan.

execution_job_id.description: ADMIN-003: 대량 보정은 동기 API 가 아니라 검토 가능한 큐 작업으로 실행한다.

AudienceCriteria.description: The parameters an audience type needs. Unused fields for a given type are ignored.

AudienceType.description: Who a campaign is for (CAMPAIGN-001 대상).

chain_intact.description:
Whether this entry still chains to its predecessor (§12.5 변조 탐지). `false` means
the row, or one before it, is not what it was when it was written.

Benefit.description: The discount a coupon grants, in the form the calculator needs.

free_item_ids.description: 무료 품목 대상. One or more catalogue ids.

display_name.description: Defaults to the Firebase display name, then to a generated nickname.

registration_no.description: 사업자등록번호. Stored encrypted plus a keyed hash for duplicate detection.

Campaign.description: A campaign as both the owner app and the admin app read it.

issued_count.description:
§8.4 counts PENDING, AVAILABLE, RESERVED, USED and EXPIRED instances; only
ISSUE_FAILED is excluded. There is no separate reserved figure because §13.2 issues
and counts inside one transaction — see the Phase 4 migration for why the column is
gone rather than permanently zero.

restore_quantity_on_revoke.description: Fixed at creation and never editable afterwards (§8.4).

revoke_policy.description: CAMPAIGN-007: 발급 후 취소는 회수 정책을 명시한다.

restore_coupon.description:
REDEEM-004: 원 캠페인이 아직 유효하고 쿠폰 만료 전이면 `AVAILABLE` 복원을
선택할 수 있다.

reference_price.description: Reference price only. The price that counts is the one entered at the till (§8.3).

sku.description: The store's own SKU. Optional — most small shops do not have one (§8.3).

already_claimed.description:
True when this call returned a coupon the customer already had. §11.3 requires a
repeat request to answer with the existing coupon id rather than an error.

remaining_quantity.description: What is left after this claim, or `None` while the campaign is unlimited.

order.description:
Echoed so a mismatch between what the owner saw and what they are approving is
caught rather than silently reconciled (§13.3-2 주문 hash).

acknowledge_duplicate.description:
Approve despite a duplicate warning, having entered a distinct order reference
(STAMP-003).

preview_id.description:
Echoed from the preview. Recorded for support, never trusted as a substitute for
re-validation (§11.4).

document_version.description: Version label of the document shown to the user, e.g. `2026-08-01`.

source.description: The screen that collected the consent (§9.4), e.g. `signup`, `settings/alerts`.

store_id.description: Required for store-scoped consent, rejected otherwise.

ConsentScope.description: The consent scopes from the §9.4 table.

ConsentState.description: One consent as it stands right now, derived from the latest event.

CouponConditions.description: Everything a coupon carries about *how* it may be spent, frozen at issuance (§8.5).

allowed_weekdays.description: `0` is Sunday. Empty means every day (§8.5, CAMPAIGN-001).

external_discount_stackable.description:
Whether the store said its own in-house discounts may be combined (§5.4). The
system cannot verify an external discount, so this is shown, not enforced.

timezone.description:
The store's zone at issuance. A later zone change does not move an absolute
expiry (§5.2), but the weekday/hour window is a local-time concept and needs one.

CouponStatusEvent.description: One state change, for the "what happened to my coupon" history.

CreateCampaignRequest.description:
The campaign draft form (CAMPAIGN-001), in the order the wizard collects it:
혜택 → 사용 조건 → 대상 → 수량 → 일정 → 알림.

restore_quantity_on_revoke.description: §8.4: fixed on the campaign, default false. Not editable afterwards.

legal_hold_until.description: §17.3: while this is in the future the subject's data cannot be erased.

ends_at.description: Optional absolute end of the version.

slug.description:
Public URL segment. Validated by [`ensure_valid_slug`], which mirrors the
`ck_stores_slug_format` CHECK constraint.

DailyCounts.description: §6.3's dashboard row. Gross and reversal are separate columns on purpose.

active_customer_count.description: Distinct customers seen. Withheld below the privacy floor.

stamp_earned_count.description: 총 발생치: accruals recorded, before reversals.

DailyMetrics.description: One business day for one store.

computed_through.description: When the figures were last recomputed.

oneOf.description: `null` while [`AggregationState::Pending`], so a client cannot render a zero.

suppressed.description:
True when the cohort behind this day is below the privacy floor and the breakdown
has been withheld (§19 소규모 집단).

Discount.description: What a coupon is worth against one order.

eligible_amount.description: The part of the order the benefit applies to, after item restrictions (§8.3).

EnqueuedJob.description: The outcome of registering a job (§14.5 steps 1–2, JOB-001).

deduplicated.description:
True when this call found an existing job rather than creating one. The caller
must not treat that as an error: JOB-001 says the second registration returns the
first job's id.

ErrorBody.description: Wire shape of a failure. Matches the example in §11.1 exactly.

FieldError.description: One invalid field, for a form to highlight.

FreeItemAward.description: The item a 무료 품목 coupon actually gave away.

JobAttempt.description: One try, with why it ended (§14.7).

JobSummary.description: A job as the admin queue view lists it (§11.5 `GET /admin/jobs`).

JobType.description:
The `{job_type}` component of a unique key (§14.3), and the operational policy each
kind of work carries (§14.6).

LocalTimeRange.description: One `HH:MM`–`HH:MM` window a coupon may be used in, in the store's local time.

end.description: `HH:MM`, exclusive — the same `[start, end)` rule as every other period (§5.2).

active_policy_id.description: The version accruals are being judged against right now, if any.

scheduled_policy_id.description: The version that takes over at its `starts_at` (§6.3 shows this as "다음 예약").

LoyaltyPolicy.description: One version, as the owner app sees it.

Notification.description: One row of the consumer's inbox (§11.3 `GET /me/notifications`).

oldest_pending_age_secs.description: Seconds the oldest due delivery has been waiting.

provider_failure_rate_1h.description: §18.4: FCM/알림톡 provider 실패율, over the last hour.

suppressed_1h.description:
Suppressions are not failures — they are the consent machinery working — but a
sudden rise means a consent projection broke, so they are reported separately rather
than folded into either number.

NotificationPurpose.description:
Why a message is being sent. §15.3 turns this into a legal basis, so it is stored on
the delivery rather than re-derived: a later template reclassification must not rewrite
the basis a past send was made on.

OrderInput.description: The order as the owner typed it (§11.4 적립 승인 요청 예시).

external_order_ref.description:
Optional POS reference. STAMP-003 uses a *new* one as the owner's confirmation
that a near-duplicate really is a separate order.

OrderItemInput.description: One `order.items[]` entry from a scan request (§11.4).

catalog_item_id.description: Optional: an owner may type an item that is not in the catalogue.

internal_resolution.description: Only returned to the roles §3.3 lets act; `SUPPORT` sees `null`.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

chain_intact.description:
Whether this entry still chains to its predecessor (§12.5 변조 탐지). `false` means
the row, or one before it, is not what it was when it was written.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

items.description: A campaign as both the owner app and the admin app read it.

issued_count.description:
§8.4 counts PENDING, AVAILABLE, RESERVED, USED and EXPIRED instances; only
ISSUE_FAILED is excluded. There is no separate reserved figure because §13.2 issues
and counts inside one transaction — see the Phase 4 migration for why the column is
gone rather than permanently zero.

restore_quantity_on_revoke.description: Fixed at creation and never editable afterwards (§8.4).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

items.description: One row of the consumer's inbox (§11.3 `GET /me/notifications`).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

items.description: One row of the administrative review queue (§11.5).

submission_snapshot.description: What the owner submitted, frozen at submission time (STORE-002).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

effective_status.description:
What it means right now — `EXPIRED` once the clock has passed `expires_at`, even
if the sweep has not caught up (§18.1).

revocation_reason.description: Why it was taken away. Shown rather than hidden (§6.2).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

PolicyRules.description: Everything a draft or an active version says about earning a stamp.

daily_earning_limit.description: Accruals per business day, 1–20. `None` means unlimited (§8.1).

PreviewIssue.description: One reason an accrual cannot be approved as submitted.

error_rate.description: 5xx as a fraction of all requests (§18.4 오류율).

latency_p95_ms.description: `null` until the process has served a request.

event_id.description:
The provider's identifier for *this callback*. Its uniqueness is what makes a
replay recognisable.

provider_reference.description: The identifier we stored when the send was accepted.

PseudonymousCustomer.description:
What the owner is allowed to know about the customer in front of them (§3.1,
WALLET-005).

Every field here is either store-local or masked. There is deliberately no email, no
phone number, no Kakao identifier, and nothing about any other store.

alias.description: Stable store-local nickname, derived rather than taken from the profile.

store_customer_id.description: Store-scoped pseudonymous id. `None` until the customer's first accrual here.

PublishEstimate.description: What publishing would cost, shown before the confirmation modal (CAMPAIGN-002).

maximum_issued_quantity.description: 최대 발급 비용의 참고값 — the ceiling, not a prediction.

effective_at.description: When the version takes over. Absent or in the past means immediately.

job_id.description: The issuing job, for `DIRECT` campaigns. `None` for 선착순.

fallback_code.description: Eight digits for STORE-005, when the camera is unavailable.

key_id.description: Which signing key produced this token (§16.2).

refresh_after_seconds.description: Seconds after which the screen should request a replacement.

token.description: The signed payload to render as a QR code.

campaign_backlog.description: Jobs waiting or running, by §14.4 status.

dead_letters_last_hour.description: §18.4: dead-letter 신규 발생, over the last hour.

outbox_unpublished_age_secs.description:
§18.4: outbox unpublished age. Seconds since the oldest unpublished row was written;
zero when the outbox is empty. A rising value is JOB-005 in progress.

stalled_jobs.description:
Jobs that have been `RUNNING` past their visibility timeout — a worker died, or is
wedged.

status.description: `ready` or `not_ready`. `degraded` components do not change it.

reapplied.description:
How many subjects were found alive again and re-erased. Non-zero after a restore is
expected; non-zero at any other time means something wrote a person back.

ReasonRequest.description: The reason §11.5 requires on every administrative action.

coupon_restored.description: Whether cancelling put the coupon back in the wallet (REDEEM-004).

voidable_until.description: Until when the owner may still undo this themselves — 사용 취소 10분 (§8.6).

token.description:
The FCM registration token. Stored encrypted with a keyed lookup hash beside it, so
a duplicate registration is recognisable without the plaintext being searchable
(§16.5).

case_id.description: §3.3 and ADMIN-006: the case is the record of who asked, when, and by what deadline.

scopes.description: Categories to erase. Empty means every category the policy table marks erasable.

Reservation.description: What the owner is shown before approving (§13.3 예약 4).

external_discount_stackable.description:
Whether the store said its own discounts may be combined. Shown to the owner
because §5.4 says the system cannot verify an external discount.

coupon_id.description: Which coupon the customer chose (REDEEM-001 step 2).

owner_session_id.description:
The till session. REDEEM-002 allows one active reservation per owner session, so
two tills in one shop can serve two customers but one till cannot start two sales.

qr_token.description: The customer's rotating QR, exactly as the accrual path takes it (§16.2).

erasable_on_request.description:
Whether a subject may have this category erased on request, or whether a statutory
retention keeps it until the period runs out (§17.3, ADMIN-006 삭제).

public_reason.description: Shown to the owner (STORE-002 보완 요청 사유).

reason.description: Internal reviewer note. §11.5 requires a reason on every administrative change.

case_id.description:
The case this revocation belongs to. It is also the job key's operation version, so
two revocations of one campaign need two cases to authorise them (§14.3).

RevokePolicy.description: What cancelling does to coupons already in wallets (CAMPAIGN-007).

RewardDefinition.description: The reward a completed board pays out.

customer_notice.description: The notice STAMP-001 requires before a policy may go live.

description.description: The usage conditions in the customer's words.

store_id.description: Set for store-scoped roles. Phase 1 grants only account-wide roles.

ScanRequest.description: How the owner identified the customer. Exactly one must be present.

fallback_code.description: The eight digits from the customer's screen (STORE-005).

qr_token.description: The signed payload read from the camera.

qr_expires_at.description: When the presented QR stops being usable, so the owner knows how long they have.

self_transaction.description:
True when the owner is scanning their own consumer profile (SEC-004). Not blocked,
but recorded and shown.

valid_after.description: Every token issued before this instant is refused, whatever Firebase thinks.

StampBoard.description: The stamp board as both apps render it (§8.1: `N/10`, 가장 이른 도장 만료).

earliest_expiry.description: The soonest any currently-held stamp expires.

expiring_within_seven_days.description: Stamps that expire within seven days (§6.2 홈 우선 노출).

remaining_to_goal.description: How many more stamps until the next reward.

StampPreview.description:
`POST /owner/stamp-transactions/preview` (§11.4).

Returns 200 even when the accrual would be refused, with the reasons listed: the scan
screen's REVIEW step has to *show* why (§6.3), and an error response cannot carry the
customer and board context it needs to do that. `confirm` re-checks everything, so a
stale or forged preview buys nothing (§11.4).

blockers.description: Blocking. `approvable` is false whenever this is non-empty.

eligible_amount.description: The part of the order that counts, after item restrictions (§8.3).

next_business_day_start.description: Start of the next business day, for the "come back tomorrow" message (STAMP-005).

stamps_expire_at.description: When the stamps this order would grant expire.

warnings.description: Non-blocking: shown to the owner before they approve (STAMP-003, SEC-004).

StampTransaction.description: The result of `POST /owner/stamp-transactions` and of a reversal.

revoked_reward_ids.description: Rewards taken back by a reversal (STAMP-007).

voidable_until.description: Until when the owner may still reverse this themselves (§8.6).

business_day_cutoff.description: Local time a business day rolls over, `HH:MM:SS`.

business_profile_complete.description: Whether the encrypted business-identity record has been filled in.

StoreReviewQueueEntry.description: One row of the administrative review queue (§11.5).

submission_snapshot.description: What the owner submitted, frozen at submission time (STORE-002).

public_reason.description: Reason shown to the owner. Internal reviewer notes are never returned here.

SuppressionReason.description:
Why a channel was not used. Recorded on the delivery so "we did not send" is always
answerable (§15.4 `SUPPRESSED`).

approved_by_user_id.description:
The second administrator, for a permanent sanction (§3.3 이중 확인). Must differ from
the requester; the database enforces it.

expires_at.description:
Required for `TEMPORARY`, refused for `PERMANENT` — a permanent sanction with an end
date is a temporary one under the wrong label (ADMIN-002).

TimelineEvent.description: One thing that happened, from whichever table recorded it.

TotalQuantity.description:
§8.4's two total-quantity expressions, kept apart on the wire.

The alternative — a nullable number where `null` means unlimited — is exactly what
§8.4 warns against, because "no ceiling named" and "no ceiling at all" then look the
same to every reader.

UpdateCampaignRequest.description: A draft edit, or one of the few post-publication changes CAMPAIGN-008 allows.

public_resolution.description: ADMIN-002: 공개 가능한 사유와 내부 사유를 분리한다.

oneOf.description: Deactivating keeps the item in every snapshot that already names it (§8.3).

notification_ids.description: Ids to act on. Empty with `all: true` means "everything currently unread".

version.description: Expected `version`; may also be supplied as `If-Match`.

reason.description: §11.5 requires a reason on every administrative change.

oneOf.description: Business identity, required before review. Encrypted at rest (§16.5).

version.description: Expected `version`; may also be supplied as `If-Match`.

consumer_key.description:
Stable pseudonymous identifier. Safe to show a store owner; never put it in a QR
payload (§16.2).

effective_status.description:
What it means right now — `EXPIRED` once the clock has passed `expires_at`, even
if the sweep has not caught up (§18.1).

revocation_reason.description: Why it was taken away. Shown rather than hidden (§6.2).

condition_snapshot.description:
The conditions frozen at issuance. A later policy edit does not change them
(§8.5).

WalletStampBoard.description: One store's board in the wallet (§8.1: `N/10`, 가장 이른 도장 만료, 리워드 내용).

as_of.description: Server time the balances were judged against, so a client can show staleness.
